objectives.teacher: Identify and use mon père, ma mère, mon frère and ma sœur to introduce family members with Voici… and Il/Elle s’appelle…, selecting mon or ma to match the noun.
Describe family members’ ages using Il/Elle a… ans with numbers from 1 to 20, distinguishing a for age from est for description.
Write three or four linked sentences introducing family members and describing their ages and personalities, using et and making gentil/gentille and amusant/amusante agree with il or elle.
